title: Every Joomla quickstart pins Claude Cowork for Joomla 0.24.28 (the self-updater never downloads inside a visitor's request), with the published asset's bytes and sha256, in both catalogues
steps: S1: Read every Joomla entry with a cowork pin in apps/tracy-web/src/quickstarts.json and packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/scripts/provision/quickstarts.json.
expect: S1: every Joomla pin is version 0.24.28 or later (0.24.28 exactly when this PR merged: bytes 42591963, sha256 db8c3b54…cc92cc0ae; the exact current asset is held by the case of the PR that moved the pin last); the provision copy pins the same.
evidence: Before this PR every Joomla quickstart pinned 0.24.27, whose self-updater read the ~42 MB package into memory in a visitor's request: 61 memory fatals in 24 h on 20 of 24 fleet01 demos, each appending Joomla's 500 Whoops page to the visitor's page
fence: Every contract of 0.24.27 is carried unchanged: pin-joomla-cowork.mjs refuses a release whose zip does not carry the recorded contract files byte for byte
